verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk export of a user's hosted company records, runs and documents in open formats so the user can leave. The 'company and work in progress come with you' claim is about switching AI models within Ultrametric, not exporting out of it. Per-record JSON retrieval via `context get --json` and the published schemas are building blocks a developer could use, not a documented export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
